description: Escape of water from Flat 4 through the kitchen ceiling of Flat 3 (reported by the Flat 3 occupier by phone 19:35 Sat 10/10). Tenant away 9-12 Oct.

history.note: Swift assigned as emergency. Out-of-hours key holder sent for emergency entry. Caller told to keep away from the wet light fitting and isolate that circuit if safe.
Tenant called (voicemail) and sent SMS and email explaining emergency entry.
Entered with key holder. Stopcock off. Cause: failed compression joint on the cold feed under the kitchen sink. Joint replaced, water back on, no further leak. Photos taken. Damaged joint kept.
Landlord Ben Hartley emailed: leak stopped, Flat 3 kitchen ceiling damaged, insurance claim likely on the Hartley Homes block policy.
